//: Lighthouse CI budgets. Run by .github/workflows/lighthouse.yml against a locally-served production build, so a regression is caught in the PR rather than at the monthly audit in OPERATIONS.md §5.

settings.//: Mobile, simulated slow 4G. Desktop scores flatter and would hide exactly the regressions that matter to a South African audience on a phone.
settings.//preset: There was a "preset": "perf" here. It sets onlyCategories: ['performance'], so accessibility, best-practices and SEO were never collected — and every assertion below that names them, including canonical, hreflang and is-crawlable, had no data to assert on. Four of the eleven checks in this file were decorative. Removed so the run collects what the assertions ask for.

assertions.//1: Core Web Vitals, asserted directly rather than trusting the rolled-up score, which can stay green while one vital degrades.
assertions.//2: The specific regressions this codebase has already had once.
